source: Frozen previously tested g1h1 source, plus only Context reference and bounded per-runtime config cache and tests. Excludes unrelated current workspace changes.
protocol: Serial before/after/after/before; fresh process/directory for every run. After warmup: 30s baseline,60s HTTP,60s Paseo,120s mixed,180s natural cooling. Same representative synthetic topology/configuration previously validated as four-runtime/two-root fixture. Not real business traffic or dependencies. No debugger, injected helper or forced GC. Readonly proc metadata and limited isolated-runtime smaps snapshots.
expected_http_status: Fixture deliberately returns a validated 503 every twentieth HTTP worker request; zero validation failures is not zero non-2xx responses.

safety.result: success; exit 0; inactive; all four runtime PIDs gone

interpretation: Whole-package GC allocation rate improvement repeats closely in both arms: approximately 6.4% HTTP,53.6% Paseo,13.0% mixed. Cumulative allocation is churn, not live bytes.

Mixed-load anonymous tail medians: before 43.62-55.56 MiB,after 38.95-46.25 MiB. Ranges overlap; single-run RSS improvements are not guaranteed. Adjacent AB/BA comparisons favor candidate, but two runs per package do not establish statistical or long-term acceptance.

Natural-cooling anonymous tail medians: before 27.89-37.08 MiB,after 27.41-35.83 MiB. Adjacent pair differences only 0.48-1.25 MiB. Lower absolute reclaimed MiB for candidate reflects lower pressure starting point and is not itself a regression.

Boehm mapped heap declines naturally after cooling; free bytes and epochs show collection/reuse under load. Mapped capacity is not physical RSS. No positive finding of sustained unbounded growth in these short phases; no 24-hour/no-leak proof.

File-backed RSS varies even within baseline package:  natural-end RssFile 21,860 vs 27,776 KiB; candidate 27,772 vs 27,944 KiB. Isolated smaps show executable/shared-library clean pages. Text section grew only 2816 bytes,rodata shrank 8928 bytes. Exact trigger of file-page residency variation unproven; do not label this anonymous leak or 6 MiB code growth.
Business remains old 0890d931 package with 126.3125MiB anonymous memory. This candidate has not been deployed to bodytest; no real-business memory benefit is claimed.
